title: leakcheck: screening reported classification results for the resampling-before-splitting artefact

creators.name: Le Ngoc, Hieu
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Information Technology 2, Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology

creators.name: Huynh Ngoc Thanh, Trung
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Data Science, University of Finance – Marketing

description:
leakcheck screens reported binary classification summaries for a controlled resampling-before-splitting signature. Version v1.0.1 uses a screening score and neutral review bands, rejects unsupported model families with ValueError, and keeps the existing v1.0.0 JSON model unchanged (SHA-256 6ad86351f6458c2318e7e88426dd67f3262b94d020753d245ef600df6ff25aa1).

The controlled corpus has 11,200 matched comparisons from 41 source datasets. Dataset-held-out AUC is 0.795 (cluster interval 0.743–0.849). Baselines, grouped uncertainty, per-source results, input sensitivity, and JSON-only interface demonstrations accompany the code. The full model has not demonstrated an advantage over F1-only or logistic baselines. The score is not a probability that a paper contains leakage. External diagnostic validation, hosted CI and a numerical test-coverage percentage have not been established.
